environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a public subnet with internet gateway route. Task role has sts:AssumeRole with Resource '*'. ALLOWED_ASSUME_ROLES set to 'arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/service-'. Another container in the same task (sidecar pattern) is compromised via SSRF. The attacker can POST to localhost:9999 and assume arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/service-admin (matches prefix 'service-'). Exfiltrated credentials are sent to attacker-controlled endpoint via the internet gateway.
